description: Unit tests for functions in the 'gn' build system, including assertions, 'defined' checks, list splitting, string hashing, joining, splitting, and print stack trace functionality.

methods.name: Assert
methods.description: Tests for the 'assert' function, including passing, failing, and usage error cases.

methods.name: Defined
methods.description: Tests for the 'defined' function, checking undefined, defined, accessor, and subscript scenarios.

methods.name: FunctionsWithBlock
methods.description: Tests that functions which do not accept blocks throw errors when blocks are supplied.

methods.name: SplitList
methods.description: Tests for the 'split_list' function with various input lists and split sizes.

methods.name: StringHash
methods.description: Tests for the 'string_hash' function with correct usage and error detection.

methods.name: StringJoin
methods.description: Tests for the 'string_join' function with various string lists and separators, including error cases.

methods.name: StringReplace
methods.description: Tests for the 'string_replace' function with different replacement scenarios.

methods.name: StringSplit
methods.description: Tests for the 'string_split' function with whitespace and string separator splitting, including errors.

methods.name: DeclareArgs
methods.description: Tests for declaring arguments and reading their values inside and outside declare_args blocks.

methods.name: NotNeeded
methods.description: Test for the 'not_needed' function with a block argument.

methods.name: PrintStackTraceWithOneTemplate
methods.description: Tests printing stack trace within a single template invocation.

methods.name: PrintStackTraceWithNoTemplates
methods.description: Tests printing stack trace with no templates defined.

methods.name: PrintStackTraceWithNestedTemplates
methods.description: Tests printing stack trace with nested template calls.

methods.name: PrintStackTraceWithNonTemplateScopes
methods.description: Tests printing stack trace with non-template scopes involved.

methods.name: PrintStackTraceWithNonTemplateScopesBetweenTemplateInvocations
methods.description: Tests printing stack trace with scopes between template calls.

methods.name: PrintStackTraceWithTemplateDefinedWithinATemplate
methods.description: Tests printing stack trace when a template is defined within another template.
